description: This file defines the 'SerializationException' class within the Laminas Diactoros exception namespace. It extends 'UnexpectedValueException' and provides static methods to generate specific exception instances related to request and status line validation errors.

classes.name: SerializationException
classes.description: Custom exception class for serialization errors extending the standard PHP 'UnexpectedValueException'. It includes static methods for specific error scenarios.

methods.name: forInvalidRequestLine
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of 'SerializationException' for an invalid request line error.

methods.name: forInvalidStatusLine
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of 'SerializationException' for a missing or invalid status line error.
